newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco health workers plan third strike.
newsitem.headline: Morocco health workers plan third strike.

text.p: Moroccan public health workers will hold a three-day strike from July 22 to 24 after two shorter stoppages failed to push the government into responding to their grievances, their union said on Sunday.

The Democratic Labour Confederation in a statement sent to Reuters said the government had failed to reply to their two-day strike last week to press for pay increases and compensation for medical risks. That protest followed a similar two-day stoppage the week before.
Emergency services are being provided, said the union, which last week reported that 92 to 100 percent of staff observed the protest in the main medical centres.
The union said there were 3,500 doctors and 40,000 paramedical staff in the public sector. It was not clear if all were members of the union.
Health Ministry officials were not available for comment.
